site.sitedescription: One main inflow (Urtene) in the west and one outflow (Urtene) in the east. There are fragmented stands of Alnus glutinosa and Fraxinus excelsior along the lake shore. The flat areas around the lake are either intensivley used for agriculture or covered by settlements and infrastructure. The earliest archaeological findings date back to ca. 15,000 cal BP (reindeer hunter camp at Moosbühl). Several Neolithic lake-shore settlements.
